name: Code of the District of Columbia
label: D.C. Code
record_note: The D.C. Code at each of the DC Council's 396 dated publications from 2021-10-18 to 2026-10-27, via DCCouncil/law-xml-codified; built 2026-10-28.
author: the D.C. Law or Act (or Act of Congress) the section's new History notes name (Law trailer); otherwise the publication
granularity: the law's effective date where it falls between two publications; otherwise the publication date (Published trailer)

scope.when_absent: the D.C. Code records applicability in each law's notes (Applicability annotations), not case by case

default_reach.rule: presumption against retroactivity: a statute is not applied to events completed before its enactment absent clear legislative intent
default_reach.authority: Landgraf v. USI Film Products, 511 U.S. 244 (1994), applied by the D.C. Court of Appeals
